text:
sam: Heads-up — private delivery staging window tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC. Packaging will include v1.8.2-offline and the delta installer. Need final checksum signoff + KMS handoff before we start transport. @nicole @ryan please confirm you can be on the 01:30 preflight and the 02:00 window.

nicole: Can do. I'll run checksum + cosign verify at 01:30 UTC. I'll also rotate the signer key and publish timestamped cosign bundle.

dev-packager: FYI shrinkwrap changed to include submanifest v2 (adds compressed diff). Packaging note: the delta installer uses chunking; ensure receiver supports manifest-chunks header.

maya: Suggest canary at 10% for the first 30m. If we see checksum mismatch or transport failure, we fallback to pinned v1.8.1 and abort remaining transports.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release artifact created: artifact_id=3701234567-offline v=1.8.2-offline signer=dev-packager status=queued :package:

sam: Good. To be explicit on rollback: T+0–35m we evaluate canary; if errors > 2% or any manifest cosign failure, we stop and pin to v1.8.1. If transport partially completes, we'll run the artifact-evacuate job.

nicole: Verification commands I'll run during preflight:

```
# checksum
sha256sum release-v1.8.2-offline.tar.gz
# verify cosign signature
cosign verify --key cosign.pub release-v1.8.2-offline.tar.gz
```

dev-packager: I pushed the signed submanifest to s3://private-release/3701234567/submanifest.json and uploaded the sealed bundle to the offsite mirror. Short checksum: sha256:3f7b9c1a... (full in preflight notes).

ryan: I'll be on-call for the window. If we need to escalate, ping me on pager and @sam. I'll watch transport logs and mirror health.

sam: We'll timebox the rollback decision at T+35m. If we don't have agreement by then, default is to abort and pin back. Also: ensure the receiver has the new manifest-chunks header; ops will validate at 01:45.

maya: :thumbsup: I'll watch canary dashboards. If latency or error-rate regresses by >10% we pull.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: transport started at 02:05 UTC for artifact_id=3701234567-offline, estimated duration=00:40, canary=10%

sam: Nice. After transport completes, leave a short release notes blurb for private delivery: include checksum, cosign bundle link, signer, observed canary metrics and any deviation from preflight.

nicole: Will do. I'll post the cosign bundle link and checksum in the release notes thread immediately after validation.

dev-packager: One more: if we need emergency rebuild, I have an isolated build env ready under "packager/emergency" — takes ~22m to produce a new signed bundle. Not ideal but available.

sam: Good to have. Thanks everyone — preflight at 01:30, staging window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Ping this thread for quick status updates during the window.
